candidates.business_summary: We breed and sell crop seed - mainly corn and soybeans under the Pioneer brand - to farmers worldwide, and license our genetics and trait technology to other seed companies. Farmers buy new seed every season, so revenue recurs annually and is priced per bag on the yield advantage our germplasm delivers. 2025 net sales were $9.9B with $2.6B of operating EBITDA; we were Corteva's seed segment until the October 2026 spin-off.

candidates.business_summary: We design, build and install the power-distribution and structural systems that sit inside a data hall - remote power panels, busway and branch whips, steel framing and our SkyBridge modular overhead platform - and we sell them to hyperscale, colocation and AI cloud operators. Revenue is project-based hardware plus installation, sold mostly to a handful of very large customers; 2025 sales were $448M, up 147%, with about $1.1B of backlog. Olympus Partners controls about 85% of the vote.

candidates.business_summary: We make siRNA drugs that silence the gene behind a disease so the harmful protein is never made. Our lead, onvuzosiran, shuts down liver production of plasma kallikrein to prevent hereditary angioedema attacks and is in Phase 3; behind it sit agazisiran for complement-driven kidney and eye disease and a Factor XI program for stroke prevention. We have no product revenue - AbbVie paid $335M upfront in 2025 to license our platform and owes milestones and royalties.
